_comment: Detect the bag family from the order. The bag weight/type is read FROM the order (product name + Cấu trúc spec). family picks the template + formula set.

opp._aka: Bao BOPP in ống đồng (40KG putty bags, e.g. 4 Oranges)
opp.template: templates/Định mức - OPP (Bao BOPP in ống đồng).xlsx

paper_kp._aka: Bao KP / Bao giấy in flexo (25KG, e.g. Tân Châu AM-20)
paper_kp.template: templates/Định mức - Bao giấy (KP / in offset).xlsx

detection: 1. Lowercase the product name + Cấu trúc spec.
2. If any opp.name_keywords OR opp.spec_keywords present -> family 'opp'.
3. Else if any paper_kp keywords -> family 'paper_kp'.
4. Fallback: weight in product name ('40kg'->opp, '25kg'->paper_kp); else ask.
Weight is informational (appears in product name like '...40KG'); the family is what selects the template.
